title.zh: 寻找旋转排序数组中的最小值 II
title.en: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array II

desc.zh: 重复值为什么让二分查找退化？保留至少一个最小值。
desc.en: See why duplicates weaken binary search, while preserving a minimum.

complexity: O(n) worst-case time; O(1) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Duplicate-aware binary search
concepts.description: Derive safe interval reductions when endpoint values can be equal.

concepts.name: Minimum-preserving invariant
concepts.description: Keep at least one global minimum while strictly shrinking the interval.
